notes: Non-controlled interventional prospective multicentre study, an extension (GTAM 2) of the Spanish Group of Atropine Treatment for Myopia Control study (GTAM 1); recruited October 2017 to April 2019 in 12 Spanish centres.
Inclusion criteria (pre-treatment): age 6–14 years, myopia −2.00 to −6.00 D, astigmatism < 1.50 D, documented annual progression of at least 0.50 D under cycloplegia; no prior myopia control.
AL and anterior chamber depth by IOLMaster (Carl Zeiss Meditec), average of 6 measurements; units mm as stated in Tab2.

Attrition: 24 of 105 enrolled children left the study (19 missed scheduled visits, 1 changed to orthokeratology, 4 adverse events); 10 missed the 20-month visit but stayed enrolled; 81 reached the 24-month visit and were analysed.
Refraction (cycloplegic SE), anterior chamber depth, pupil size and visual acuity are tabulated in Tab2 and are not used.

series.notes: mean ± SD; eyes not stated for Table 2 (Methods pool both eyes as one value per patient for the correlation analysis), used as tabulated; month 0 and month 12 from the first-year block (R4C2, R4C3), month 24 from the 2-year block (R20C3); all three blocks of Tab2 tabulate the same 81 children (n = 81 in each block heading); complete-case set admitted under inclusion 5: 105 enrolled in GTAM 1, 92 continued in GTAM 2, 81 reached the 24-month visit (81/105 = 77%)
